item.title: Gigaverse announces open-world social RPG Gigaverse Online
item.summary: Gigaverse is preparing to move beyond its current browser-based dungeon RPG with Gigaverse Online, a new open-world social RPG the team says is now only a few months from launch. The project describes the new game as being designed for long-term sustainability, entertainment and broader appeal beyond the relatively small crypto-native gaming market.
